standard.name: agentskills
standard.note: The rules in bin/lib/rules.mjs mirror the spec at this hash. Re-pinning is a deliberate act after reconciling the mirror rule by rule.

gates.name: acceptance
gates.fix: make the criterion true or hand it back; close a green requirement; give every requirement a status

gates.name: contracts
gates.fix: keep the seam's promise or hand it back; a drawing reads its task's status from its requirement

gates.name: units
gates.fix: fix the unit; never edit the test to pass

gates.name: rules
gates.fix: obey the skill rules (name, description, MIT, budget, depth, no vendor, no dash)

gates.name: drawings
gates.fix: give the drawing the template's six sections in order, one labelled edge and one contract test per seam, every criterion in the strategy table, and a requirement of the same task

gates.name: ledger
gates.fix: evidence the rung or lower it

gates.name: format
gates.fix: npx prettier --write . (npm install first if the formatter is missing)

gates.evidence: the ask itself, in the requirement's opening line

gates.act: approves the drawing before code is written
gates.evidence: the drawing with its seams, decisions and red contract tests
gates.recorded: the merge of the drawing's pull request

gates.act: gives the key for one release to one target
gates.evidence: a green board and the release plan
